description: Formulation of a Space Policy for Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-18 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Space technology and its applications have become indispensable components of national development, yielding substantial benefits across critical sectors such as disaster management, communication, defence, environmental monitoring and economic innovation. Taking into account the increasing strategic significance of space technologies, the need of having a unified national framework for the same has been identified. Therefore, the Ministry of Science and Technology has planned to develop a National Space Policy. The proposed Policy will streamline and facilitate international cooperation, enhance Sri Lanka's effectiveness in global space governance mechanisms, and ensure that all national space activities are conducted in accordance with international obligations, treaties and standards. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Science and Technology to appoint an Expert Committee with specialized technical knowledge to formulate the National Space Policy, was approved by the Cabinet.
